tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background behind everything (body). Dark: soft ink, never #000.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, task rows, navbar, filter bar: level 1.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Modals, menus, toasts, popovers: level 2. In dark it is lighter, not just shadowed.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells: input fields in dark, skeleton base, table headers, code.

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: Text input, select and checkbox fill. Dark: recessed below surface so fields read as wells.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for rows, ghost buttons, menu items. The grey badge fills (status-todo-soft, priority-low-soft) sit one step darker in light and one step lighter in dark, so they stay visible on a hovered row.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind modals.

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: Primary text on canvas, surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken.

tokens.name: fg-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: descriptions, meta, table headers. Same grounds as fg.

tokens.name: fg-subtle
tokens.usage: Placeholders, timestamps, helper text. Still 4.5:1 on canvas/surface/raised.

tokens.name: fg-primary
tokens.usage: Links and primary-tinted text on surface, canvas and primary-soft.

tokens.name: fg-accent
tokens.usage: Saffron text on surface and accent-soft (e.g. "Due today").

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text/icons on primary and primary-hover fills. Dark theme flips to deep pine.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on accent fill (count bubbles, brand mark).

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on danger fills (destructive buttons).

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Dividers and card outlines. Decorative: not relied on to find a control.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Input, select and checkbox outlines: 3:1 on surface and canvas.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, selected states, active nav. Dark: desaturated so it does not glow.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed fill for primary.

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Selected row, active filter chip, focus-within tint.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Warm accent fill: brand mark, unread/count bubble, "today" marker. Use sparingly.

tokens.name: brand-panel
tokens.usage: Login/register brand panel behind the TileBoard. Dark: deep pine so the large area does not glow.

tokens.name: on-brand-panel
tokens.usage: Text on brand-panel; TileBoard tiles use it at /8 (scattered) and /15 (sorted).

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background for accent highlights.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px outline on the element's own edge (outline-offset -1px), keyboard only. 3:1 on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive button fill, error icon, overdue icon.

tokens.name: danger-hover
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed for danger.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Error/overdue tinted background, danger-zone panel.

tokens.name: danger-fg
tokens.usage: Error text: inline field errors, toast titles, on danger-soft and surface.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success icon and solid mark.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Success tinted background.

tokens.name: success-fg
tokens.usage: Success text on success-soft and surface.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning icon and solid mark.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Warning tinted background.

tokens.name: warning-fg
tokens.usage: Warning text on warning-soft and surface.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Info icon and solid mark.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Info tinted background.

tokens.name: info-fg
tokens.usage: Info text on info-soft and surface.

tokens.name: status-todo
tokens.usage: To Do: icon/dot. Always beside the label "To Do" + Circle icon.

tokens.name: status-todo-soft
tokens.usage: To Do badge background. One step away from surface-hover so it shows on hovered rows.

tokens.name: status-todo-fg
tokens.usage: To Do badge text on status-todo-soft.

tokens.name: status-progress
tokens.usage: In Progress: icon/dot, with CircleDashed/half icon + label.

tokens.name: status-progress-soft
tokens.usage: In Progress badge background.

tokens.name: status-progress-fg
tokens.usage: In Progress badge text on status-progress-soft.

tokens.name: status-done
tokens.usage: Done: icon/dot, with CircleCheck icon + label.

tokens.name: status-done-soft
tokens.usage: Done badge background.

tokens.name: status-done-fg
tokens.usage: Done badge text on status-done-soft.

tokens.name: priority-low
tokens.usage: Low priority: 1 signal bar + label.

tokens.name: priority-low-soft
tokens.usage: Low priority badge background. One step away from surface-hover so it shows on hovered rows.

tokens.name: priority-low-fg
tokens.usage: Low priority text on priority-low-soft.

tokens.name: priority-medium
tokens.usage: Medium priority: 2 signal bars + label.

tokens.name: priority-medium-soft
tokens.usage: Medium priority badge background.

tokens.name: priority-medium-fg
tokens.usage: Medium priority text on priority-medium-soft.

tokens.name: priority-high
tokens.usage: High priority: 3 signal bars + label.

tokens.name: priority-high-soft
tokens.usage: High priority badge background.

tokens.name: priority-high-fg
tokens.usage: High priority text on priority-high-soft.

styles.name: heading

styles.name: body

styles.usage: text-body. Default UI and paragraph text (15px).

styles.name: body-sm

styles.name: label
styles.usage: text-label. Form labels, button text, nav links.

styles.name: display-ar

tokens.name: spacing
tokens.usage: Base unit. Tailwind multiplies it: p-4 = 16px, gap-3 = 12px. Use multiples only.

tokens.name: spacing-control-sm
tokens.usage: h-control-sm: small buttons and icon buttons (32px; touch-target extends the hit area to 44px).

tokens.name: spacing-control
tokens.usage: h-control: default control height on md+ (40px).

tokens.name: spacing-touch
tokens.usage: h-touch / size-touch: minimum control height below md (44px touch target).

tokens.name: spacing-control-lg
tokens.usage: h-control-lg: large buttons (sign-in, primary page CTA).

tokens.name: spacing-card
tokens.usage: p-card / px-card: inner padding of cards and panels.

tokens.name: radius-tight
tokens.usage: Badges, checkboxes, the small corners of the leaf.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects: the large corners of rounded-leaf-sm.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, modals, toasts: the large corners of rounded-leaf.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status badges, avatars, progress tracks, member chips.

tokens.name: elevation-card
tokens.usage: shadow-card: resting cards, buttons. Dark adds a 1px top highlight instead of a stronger shadow.

tokens.name: elevation-pop
tokens.usage: shadow-pop: hovered cards, toasts, menus.

tokens.name: elevation-modal
tokens.usage: shadow-modal: dialogs.

tokens.name: elevation-lip
tokens.usage: inset-shadow-lip: the 2px bottom lip on filled buttons; removed on :active for a tactile press.

duration.note: Transition durations. Every transition also gets motion-reduce:transition-none.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover/press colour changes, focus, checkbox.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Card lift, toggles, progress.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Modal and toast entrances. Nothing slower.

tokens.name: ease-flow
tokens.usage: The ease-out curve for every UI transition and entrance.

tokens.name: ease-snap
tokens.usage: Slight overshoot. Brand moments only (tiles snapping into place on the login board); never on controls.
